newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banc One upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banc One upgraded to buy.

text.p: - JP Morgan upgraded Banc One to a buy from market perform and set a 12-month stock price target at $52 a share.
- JP Morgan expects capital management and cost savings to continue to drive bank stock prices higher.
- JP Morgan said Banc One may accelerate its stock repurchase program.
- Banc One's earnings per share growth rate in 1997 and 1998 may exceed JP Morgan's projections due to share repurchases, revenue enhancements and cost savings.
- JP Morgan's current 1998 earnings estimate for Banc One is $4.07 a share.
